title: Q-YIELD-7f00974fc9: directive YEAR-SIM-1 is not holding
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --check
**Status:** closed

Intent Yield: the owner's directive YEAR-SIM-1 (A year unattended is simulated, not asserted; the system does what it says, 2026-11-21, agents/AGENTS.md:80) is not holding: its own probe `python3 -m foundation trajectory --check` fails (site/trajectory-data.js is stale: run trajectory --run --apply).

The owner said it once; the system makes it true again so it is never said twice. Fix the cause, not the probe. Prediction: the probe passes within 168 h.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --check.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T21:31:07Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
